instruction.text: There are 5 people in the band. Rounded to the nearest ten, how many people are in the band?
There were 456 people at the concert. Rounded to the nearest hundred, how many people were at the concert?
There are 65 people in the choir. Rounded to the nearest ten, how many people are in the choir?
There are 85 people in the orchestra. Rounded to the nearest hundred, how many people are in the orchestra?
There are 65221 people at the stadium. Rounded to the nearest ten, how many people were at the stadium?
And the same number rounded to the nearest hundred?
There are 4557 pupils who took the exam. Rounded to the nearest ten, how many pupils took the exam?
And the same number rounded to the nearest hundred?
There are 458881 people living in the city. Rounded to the nearest ten, how many people live in the city?
And the same number rounded to the nearest hundred?
